overview: The Outer Ramparts are Ka Vethan’s outermost defensive wall system, protecting the city from external threats and void anomalies.
history: Constructed during early Akhevan expansion to secure the city’s perimeter.
Void‑reinforcement was added after resonance instability threatened structural collapse.
Watch towers expanded to support long‑range arcane surveillance.
Praesertum decrees formalized patrol rotations and defensive doctrine.
Modern Ramparts serve as the first line of defense before the Outer Gates.
hooks: A patrol reports anomalous resonance signatures beyond the wall.
A watch tower experiences arcane interference.
A Praesertum directive requires immediate defensive alignment.
